title: A year of deploys, day by day
description: 52 weeks × 7 days · dot area = deploys that day · tiny dot = a quiet day · dashed ring = the busiest day of 2025

props.name: data
props.description: Ordered weeks containing Monday–Sunday deploy counts. Missing, negative and nonfinite values are unavailable; measured zeros retain tiny dots.

props.name: periods
props.description: Caller-supplied period labels at zero-based week positions. No calendar dates or month names are inferred.

props.name: peakLabel
props.description: Optional caller description before the maximum daily deploy count.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot proportions.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills its containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
